symptoms: fever, chills, body ache, fatigue, headache, sore throat, dry cough, runny nose
description: A common viral infection causing fever (typically 100-103°F), generalized body aches, fatigue and upper respiratory symptoms. Usually self-limiting, resolving in 3-7 days.
standard_advice: Rest, hydration (2-3L water/day), paracetamol for fever, warm fluids for throat, isolate if contagious. Seek care if fever exceeds 103°F or lasts more than 5 days.

symptoms: severe headache, throbbing pain one side of head, nausea, sensitivity to light, sensitivity to sound, visual aura
description: A neurological condition causing intense, often one-sided pulsating headaches, frequently accompanied by nausea and heightened sensitivity to light/sound.
standard_advice: Rest in a dark quiet room, avoid known triggers (caffeine withdrawal, certain foods, stress), OTC pain relief early in attack. Neurologist consult if frequent (>4/month) or worsening.

symptoms: nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal cramps, fever, dehydration, loss of appetite
description: Inflammation of the stomach and intestines, usually caused by contaminated food/water or viral infection, leading to GI distress.
standard_advice: Oral rehydration solution, BRAT diet (banana, rice, applesauce, toast), avoid dairy/spicy food. Seek urgent care if blood in stool, high fever, or signs of severe dehydration.

symptoms: burning urination, frequent urination, urgency, lower abdominal pain, cloudy urine, pelvic pain
description: Bacterial infection of the urinary tract, more common in women, causing painful and frequent urination.
standard_advice: Increase water intake, cranberry juice may help, avoid holding urine. Requires antibiotic prescription from doctor — untreated UTI can progress to kidney infection (fever, back pain = red flag).

symptoms: sneezing, runny nose, itchy eyes, nasal congestion, watery eyes, itchy throat
description: Allergic reaction to environmental triggers (pollen, dust, pet dander) causing inflammation of nasal passages.
standard_advice: Avoid known allergens, antihistamines, saline nasal rinse, air purifier. Consult doctor if symptoms persist beyond a season or affect sleep/daily function.

symptoms: dull headache, pressure around head, neck stiffness, mild to moderate pain, band-like tightness
description: The most common headache type, often triggered by stress, poor posture, or muscle tension, presenting as a constant dull ache.
standard_advice: Stress management, posture correction, adequate sleep, OTC analgesics, neck stretches. See doctor if headaches become frequent or severe.

symptoms: heartburn, chest burning, regurgitation, sour taste, bloating, worse after eating or lying down
description: Stomach acid flows back into the esophagus causing a burning sensation, often worsened by certain foods or lying down after meals.
standard_advice: Avoid spicy/fatty food, don't lie down right after eating, elevate head while sleeping, antacids. Persistent symptoms (>2 weeks) need endoscopy evaluation.

symptoms: runny nose, congestion, sneezing, mild sore throat, mild cough, low grade fever
description: A mild viral upper respiratory infection, generally resolving within a week without treatment.
standard_advice: Rest, fluids, steam inhalation, OTC decongestants if needed. Usually self-resolving; see doctor if symptoms worsen after day 5 or high fever develops.

symptoms: chest tightness, rapid heartbeat, shortness of breath, sweating, trembling, feeling of impending doom, dizziness
description: An acute episode of intense fear/anxiety with physical symptoms mimicking cardiac events; can be triggered by stress or occur without clear trigger.
standard_advice: Slow breathing exercises, grounding techniques, remove from stressful stimulus. If first episode or chest pain is severe, rule out cardiac causes with a doctor first.

symptoms: fatigue, pale skin, weakness, shortness of breath, dizziness, brittle nails, cold hands feet
description: Reduced red blood cell production due to insufficient iron, leading to reduced oxygen-carrying capacity and generalized fatigue.
standard_advice: Iron-rich diet (leafy greens, red meat, legumes), Vitamin C to aid absorption, blood test (CBC, ferritin) to confirm diagnosis and guide supplementation.

symptoms: lower back pain, muscle stiffness, pain worse with movement, localized tenderness, no radiating leg pain
description: Pain arising from muscles, ligaments or joints of the spine, often from strain, poor posture or overexertion.
standard_advice: Rest for 1-2 days then gentle movement, hot/cold compress, OTC anti-inflammatories, posture correction. Seek care if pain radiates down leg, or numbness/weakness present.

symptoms: excessive thirst, frequent urination, unexplained weight loss, fatigue, blurred vision, slow healing wounds
description: A metabolic condition where the body cannot effectively regulate blood sugar, presenting with classic thirst/urination/fatigue triad when uncontrolled.
standard_advice: Requires blood glucose/HbA1c testing promptly. Dietary modification, physical activity. This constellation of symptoms warrants medical evaluation, not just home management.

symptoms: wheezing, shortness of breath, chest tightness, cough worse at night, cough with exercise
description: A chronic respiratory condition causing airway inflammation and narrowing, leading to episodic breathing difficulty.
standard_advice: Identify and avoid triggers, prescribed inhaler use. Seek emergency care immediately if severe breathlessness, blue lips, or unable to speak full sentences — these are red-flag signs.

symptoms: red eyes, itchy eyes, watery discharge, gritty feeling, crusting eyelids
description: Inflammation of the eye's conjunctiva, commonly viral or bacterial, highly contagious in the viral/bacterial form.
standard_advice: Avoid touching/rubbing eyes, frequent hand washing, warm compress, avoid sharing towels. See doctor if vision affected or severe pain — these need urgent evaluation.

symptoms: high fever, severe headache, pain behind eyes, joint pain, muscle pain, rash, low platelet count
description: A mosquito-borne viral infection common in tropical regions, causing high fever with distinctive severe body/joint pain ("breakbone fever").
standard_advice: Hydration, paracetamol only (avoid ibuprofen/aspirin — bleeding risk), platelet monitoring via blood test. Warning signs needing immediate ER: bleeding gums, severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting.

symptoms: chest pain, pressure in chest, pain radiating to arm or jaw, sweating, shortness of breath, nausea with chest discomfort
description: Chest pain with radiation to arm/jaw and associated sweating or breathlessness can indicate cardiac origin and requires immediate evaluation.
standard_advice: This symptom combination is a medical emergency. Call emergency services / go to ER immediately — do not wait or self-treat.

symptoms: fatigue, weight gain, cold intolerance, dry skin, hair loss, constipation, slow heart rate
description: Underactive thyroid gland leading to slowed metabolism, causing a cluster of low-energy, weight, and temperature-regulation symptoms.
standard_advice: Thyroid function test (TSH, T3, T4) needed for diagnosis. Managed with hormone replacement once confirmed by a doctor.

symptoms: facial pain, pressure around nose and eyes, nasal congestion, thick nasal discharge, reduced smell, headache
description: Inflammation of the sinus cavities, often following a cold, causing facial pressure and congestion.
standard_advice: Steam inhalation, saline nasal spray, decongestants, adequate hydration. See doctor if symptoms persist beyond 10 days or fever develops (possible bacterial sinusitis).
